application: The CardDemo application is a credit card transaction management system that handles the processing, maintenance, and reporting of financial transaction data. At its core, the application manages transaction type reference data, providing the classification framework necessary for categorizing and processing credit card transactions. The system includes batch processing capabilities for extracting transaction reference data from a DB2 database to support daily Transaction Report generation, as well as batch maintenance utilities for updating and managing the Transaction Type reference table. The application operates against a DB2 database environment, with dedicated components for database initialization and ongoing maintenance operations. Overall, CardDemo serves as a comprehensive back-end solution for administering credit card transaction data, combining data extraction, reporting, and reference data maintenance functions within a structured batch processing architecture.
